test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'CREAM' is written as 'FUVEQ' and 'STOVE' is written as 'VWLZI'. How will PITCH be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ca63fa0a9b1d8d94e9032be998e74b7faff301d8847e785439c04e89b02dfd4.png] 

 For, 'CREAM' is coded as 'FUVEQ' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ed8b968a1f6707c5d4b261eb49e4c3e921d789e107725cc59fd5159b521a518.png] 

For, 'STOVE' is coded as 'VWLZI'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d389b3fe1462f5205657b4a55134d4fec6cfb1c371ed5bb34619505fd851c48.png] 

Similarly,** 'PITCH' will be coded as 'SLGGL'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/653265d5725b27ffc5c49f9c39a6c319564c69e0fc19f40c70ccf8670c5a598e.png] 

Hence the correct answer is** "Option 1". **
